name: Shop Bot
tagline: Reads your shopping bookmarks, flags restocks and prices, buys only when you say go.
description: It reads the shopping links you have saved and keeps watch on them: restocks, new arrivals from brands you like, and whether a better price has turned up elsewhere. Gift ideas come from the same pile. When something looks worth buying it comes back to you first - no order is placed until you have said go.
author: paranoidream
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
